cases.prompt: What evidence distinguishes funeral-payment contractual responsibility from paying as an agent?
Does a signed funeral invoice alone establish entitlement, and does the capital rule mean no deductions can apply?
Which two historical claim periods are explicitly separated inside chapter 40?
Can “Winter 2024 onwards” be used as the current WFP rule, or can the 15/16 September 2025 discrepancy be silently resolved?
How can IB(Y) lack contribution conditions yet be called contributory for overlap purposes?
Can an AI infer a contribution requirement from that classification or open a new IB claim because the chapter remains listed?
What distinguishes retained SDA from the dated youth transition to IB?
Can the shared 196-day language justify copying all IB rules into SDA or starting a new SDA claim now?
Which external entitlement evidence does the WMA source request from HMRC?
Must every historical WMA case have Child Benefit, or can pregnancy and backdated decisions matter?
How does the BSP source distinguish remarriage from the earlier bereavement benefits?
Can the introductory spouse/civil-partner wording automatically exclude every cohabiting parent from higher-rate BSP?
What is the difference between satisfying CA care hours and the payable qualifying-disability-benefit condition?
Can care hours for two disabled people always be added, or can hospital admission always be ignored?
What separates DLA components and medical advice from the DM’s decision?
Can a generic diagnosis or Medical Services opinion itself determine AA/DLA entitlement?
